answer: Work waits on the horizon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the onyx of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
